1. Working set is 20,002 samples, not the proposal's 100k-200k. Constrained by image-link mortality and Colab wall-clock, not by GPU. Widens confidence intervals; the between-model comparison stays valid because all models share the identical split.
2. Fakeddit's published train/validate/test split was discarded and re-split at group level to prevent repost leakage. Results are therefore not comparable to published Fakeddit baselines.
3. Only samples whose image URL was still live were usable. Link mortality may not be random with respect to content, so the working set may not represent the full corpus.
4. BLIP-2 uses the ITM retrieval checkpoint, required for the image-text matching score. Findings apply to that configuration, not to BLIP-2 captioning variants.
5. The stacking meta-learner was fitted on out-of-fold training predictions rather than validation outputs, because validation was already used for early stopping, thresholds and voting weights.
6. Variability is estimated across 3 seeds for the VLM heads and 5-fold CV for the traditional models. Differences smaller than that spread should not be reported as findings.
